title: Prefix stability of repeated runs
statement: Let $α$ be a type, let $q$ map finite bit strings to optional values in $α$, and let $t$ be a natural number. The procedure that examines successive blocks of length $t$ and returns the first value of $q$ that is present is prefix-stable: if it returns a value on a string $w$, then it returns the same value on every extension of $w$.
